sets.name: Skeleton
sets.notes: On the Loading page. Figma has one preset property for shapes and presets alike (rect (default), circle, text, paragraph and the label presets); code takes all ten values as preset, and rect, circle and text are also shape, which resize freely either way. shimmer? is isShimmering, off by default in Figma so static designs read clearly and on by default in code. Docs page: node 17885:47731.

sets.name: Suggestion
sets.notes: On the AI Label page (docs page: node 17885:57). Figma marks defaults in the value name ("insert (default)", "rest (default)"); code takes the bare value. The state axis (rest, hover, pressed, focus) is the browser's own :hover, :active and :focus-visible, never a prop; state=disabled is the native disabled button, from isDisabled or from a disabled field's or TagGroup's TagContext.

sets.name: TagGroup
sets.notes: On the Status, Count & Tag page (docs page: node 17884:2099). Figma values carry a (default) suffix on wrap, left and false; left and right are start and end in code, and disabled is isDisabled. The Tags slot (preferred values Tag and Suggestion) is children. The +n is a gray selectable Tag with no swatch (TagGroup hides it); code sizes the collapsed row by width, where Figma draws two tags and +n. Suggestions are never counted into +n and stay after it; menu items keep their tag's action (selectable toggles, link opens with a trailing arrow); remove stays on the row.

sets.name: TagInput
sets.notes: 2 spacings × 10 states: empty, filled, focus, typing, create, option menu, reordering, invalid, read-only and disabled. `spacing` is the code prop of the same name. `state` draws code's live states still: empty and filled are the tags, focus and typing are focus and the typed text (the hovered row shows its "…" when the field has a menu handler), create is a Create row in the list, option menu is the `_Option menu` open from a row's "…" (`onRename`, `onDelete`, `onColorChange`), reordering is a row lifted by its handle with the drop line and the keys in the hint (`onReorder`), and invalid, read-only and disabled are `isInvalid`, `readOnly` and `disabled`. The rows are Dropdown list Item, whose `state=dragging` and `drop indicator?` are OptionRow's `dragging` and `dropIndicator="before"`. Signed off; the library publishes it once the Specs file's text migration is ready, and the status becomes `verified` then.

sets.name: _Option menu
sets.notes: The menu a TagInput row's "…" opens: a `_Listbox` whose Header holds a small field for the name, the Figma Form (code: `TextField spacing="compact"`, Enter renames, Esc cancels), and whose Body holds Dropdown list Item rows: Delete with a trash icon and a divider, then a Color heading and one row per Tag color showing the Tag, the current one `state=selected`. It opens 4px under the "…", right-aligned to it. Each part shows only when its handler is passed.

sets.name: Tile
sets.notes: On the Iconography, Logos & Imagery page. Figma marks defaults in the value name ("32 (default)", "subtle (default)", "gray (default)"); code takes the bare value. Logo and image variants hold a media slot, which code fills with `children` or `src`. Image variants exist for gray only, since the picture covers the ground.
